Goalie GP is derived from verified game sheets, not from skater projection fields.
Names may have distinct roster classes; goalie roster status was not inferred.
Historical workbook award scorecards are not current season ratings.

verifiedSourceReadback.source: Official Brave H.C. HTO player and goalie statistics
verifiedSourceReadback.scopeLimitation: Read-only public scoring/goalie-source parity. HTO GP and aggregate stats do not qualify a player for a specific award or validate AwardScoring formulas.

independentBoxscoreParity.source: Four source-verified HTO boxscore IDs retained in Founder-approved Hot Stove game recaps
independentBoxscoreParity.qualifier: Crosscheck of scored games and goalie appearance totals, NOT an independent calculation of player award ratings.

htoPositionVerification.source: Official HTO skater POS column and separate goalie table
htoPositionVerification.semantics: HTO position listing is NOT proof of award-specific eligibility; dual-role players are position candidates only.

sourceLimitations: Current per-game HTO PIM-free observed appearances and event goal-strength evidence, not an AwardScoring discipline or special-teams score.
The original workbook's multi-PIM games definition and historical 50-100 normalization have not been validated.
No assumption that missing event categories equal a normalized score of zero; goalie discipline not derived.
The previously documented AwardScoring and JavaScript publication holds remain active.

currentGoalStrengthLedger.provenance: Exact named scorer/assistant event attribution from four official HTO public Score Summary tables
currentGoalStrengthLedger.caveat: No league or workbook historic/normalized rate inferred; zero recorded PP/SH game events is NOT a 50–100 special teams model score.

sourceLimitations: No goalie penalty in the complete published HTO penalty summaries; reporting completeness outside HTO is not independently established.
No goalie scorer or credited goal-assist in the six official Brave H.C. scoring events.
Source-level data ONLY. Historical rate baselines, model quality and discipline definitions, and 50–100 award scoring remain held.

currentHTOGamePatterns.source: Official HTO four game-level box scores and independently reconciled published season aggregate

workbookRookieRosterWatch.source: Master Workbook AwardScoring -> First Season, Rookie Status, Current Roster Status
workbookRookieRosterWatch.caveat: Roster-based first-season full-time watch only. Saved workbook not current for award scoring; this is not an award ranking, nominee declaration, or proof of all Rookie of the Year eligibility conditions.

currentRawSourceReadiness.warning: These are actual HTO raw season statistics, NOT normalized AwardScoring public 50–100 subscores or candidate ranks. HTO source alone cannot reproduce historical baselines, per-game award helpers or award eligibility.

htoRookieYearReadback.caveat: HTO-listed Rookie Year is primary evidence for the unranked on-ice rookie watch. Full-time role and games played must independently match current season. The Sept 22 workbook flag remains separately retained and may conflict; no model eligibility or score is asserted.

workbookRookieYearCrosscheck.discrepancy: Jamie Rosenberg has workbook Rookie Year 2026 (PlayerInfo!AX106) and FT roster, but cached Recent Season and First Season are blank, Skater GP 0, Rookie Status 0 and Rookie Eligible 0 because his current game events were not represented in the saved workbook. Official HTO records three appearances. Do not override the workbook formula: replay source-authorized games and recalculate in a controlled replica.
workbookRookieYearCrosscheck.warning: Unranked first-year candidate visibility is supported by workbook Rookie Year corroborated with official HTO participation; cached workbook award eligibility and all current model scores remain HELD pending authoritative game-log replay and formula recalculation.
